description: This file implements a wrapper around the strerror_r function to provide a safe and portable way to retrieve error messages based on error codes, handling differences between GNU and POSIX implementations.

methods.name: safe_strerror_r
methods.description: Wraps the strerror_r function to safely retrieve error messages, handling different implementations and edge cases.

methods.name: safe_strerror
methods.description: Returns a std::string with the error message corresponding to the given error code.
